text.style: font-size: 17px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #172033

g.text: Normalized maps can hide substantial lost signal power

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #172033

g.text: Each value compares with the 53-bin / eight-window software reference over three seeds.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: #475569

g.text: More bins improve coverage, but exact bin placement matters: the 10-bin set includes 37.5 kHz; the 24-bin set does not.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: #475569

g.text: Longer FFT windows with the same number of bins cover narrower spectral slices. Short observations lose burst energy.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: #475569

g.text: Values are digital power ratios, not calibrated acoustic sensitivity or detection probability.
